notes: Agnara 1.0.4 was published from b6fa9f1a9df9f8f2940d7bc351a4d40295887686 in three protected release phases on 2026-11-10.
The final run verified all seven distributions on PyPI and created the v1.0.4 tag and GitHub Release.
The gate entries below preserve preparation history. The readiness command reports the published release until a new target is selected.

gates.title: Release commit has a clean working tree
Execution semantics are complete
gates.detail: Full pytest passed (3656 passed, 36 skipped); runtime AST matches the develop baseline. Maintainer review of 1.0.3 remains pending.

gates.title: Performance budgets are enforced
gates.detail: docs/performance/budgets.json remains numerically unchanged. Local Windows measurement exceeded three ratios on repeat; the CI performance job and maintainer review are required.

gates.title: Interoperability conformance is demonstrated
gates.detail: docs/INTEROPERABILITY.md names version-pinned host fixtures; full pytest and 32 explicit browser tests passed. Maintainer review remains pending.

gates.title: Security program is reviewed
gates.detail: docs/THREAT_MODEL.md names current adversarial review and residual risks; the full security test lane passed within pytest. Maintainer review remains pending.

gates.title: Public API is ready for stability
gates.detail: docs/PUBLIC_API.md and docs/public-api.json classify 166 exports across 13 modules. The manifest and runtime AST are unchanged. Maintainer review remains pending.

gates.title: Documentation reproduces supported applications
gates.detail: Seven wheels and seven sdists validated; all wheels installed in a fresh Python 3.14 environment with the first-party index closed, and imports and CLI smoke passed. Maintainer review remains pending.

gates.title: Publication workflow is rehearsed
gates.detail: The 1.0.3 protected publication has not been dispatched; approval and index verification remain pending.
